The same letters after the म् of the pronoun अदस् are प्रगृह्य।

Terms:

The substitution of a blank (लोप) signifies disappearance.

Terms:

The words सत् and असत् when in composition with a verb ae called गति , when used in the sense of 'respect or love' and 'disrespect or indifference'.

Terms: गति-संज्ञा

अत् is the substitute of झ after a reduplicated verbal अङ्ग (stem).

Terms: Some substitution

For the स् of अदस् there is substituted औ whereby the Nominative 1st-Case singular affix सु is elided.

Terms: सर्वनाम
According to the opinion of other Teachers, आ is substituted for the which is obtained by shortening the long आ of the feminine (under sūtra केऽणः

) of a word which has no corresponding masculine form.

Terms: Feminine इ

After अद् 'to eat' , comes the augment अट् before a सार्वधातुक affix consisting of a single consonant, according to the opinion of all grammarians.

Terms: अट् augment

When the सर्वनाम अदस् does not end in स् then there is substituted उ or ऊ for the vowel after द् , and म् for द्।

Terms: अदस् declension
